title: Mattea Conforti Is Ready to Return to the Power Universe as Elisa Marie Proctor
htmlContent:
The Power Universe has produced some of the most compelling characters in premium cable history, and few have left fans more curious about their fate than Elisa Marie Proctor, the sharp, perceptive daughter of slain defense attorney Joe Proctor. Now, the actress who brought Elisa Marie to life, Mattea Conforti, is making it clear that she is not only open to returning to the franchise but eager to do so.

In a recent appearance on The Crew Has It Podcast, hosted by Power Book II: Ghost stars Gianni Paolo and Michael Rainey Jr., Conforti opened up about her time filming the original Power series and what a return to that world would mean to her. Her candid and enthusiastic response is exactly what fans of the franchise have been waiting to hear.

Mattea Conforti Speaks Her Truth on The Crew Has It Podcast

During her sit-down on The Crew Has It, Conforti did not hold back when asked about the possibility of reprising her role. With genuine excitement in her voice, the actress reflected on what filming Power meant to her at such a young age, and how she believes she would approach the character very differently today.

"I would love to. I loved Power. Power was so much fun to film and like I was so young so it was like I feel like if I were to step back into it now, I'd really understand, you know, how to go about it differently and really get into it more. But like the days that we were filming and with Joe [Joseph Sikora], too, and like it was just so much fun. No, it was fire. And Legacy did get announced, so who knows what could happen. You know what I'm saying?"

The enthusiasm is impossible to miss. Conforti is not simply leaving the door open out of courtesy; she is actively knocking on it. Her mention of Power Legacy, the newly announced addition to the Power Universe, adds even more fuel to the fire for fans who have long wanted to see Elisa Marie's story continue.

Who Is Elisa Marie Proctor and Why Does She Matter?

For those who need a refresher, Elisa Marie Proctor is the daughter of Joe Proctor, the cunning defense attorney played by Jerry Ferrara who represented Ghost and navigated the treacherous legal landscape of the Power world. Elisa Marie appeared as an intelligent and perceptive young girl who witnessed far more than any child should, becoming an innocent casualty of the dark world her father operated in.

Joe Proctor's shocking death left fans grieving not just for the character, but for Elisa Marie, whose fate was left largely unresolved. The character's potential has never been forgotten, and with the Power Universe continuing to expand through multiple spinoffs, many have wondered when, not if, Elisa Marie would resurface.

Courtney Kemp Has Always Had a Vision for Elisa Marie

Conforti's excitement aligns with something Power creator Courtney Kemp revealed years ago. During an Instagram Live in 2020, Kemp expressed her own desire to bring Elisa Marie back and her admiration for the young actress.

"I really wanted to bring back Elisa Marie. I'm hoping to be able to do that. That actress is pretty amazing," said Kemp at the time.
View this post on Instagram

A post shared by COURTNEY KEMP (@courtneyakemp)

As previously reported by LandonBuford.com, Kemp confirmed she had a specific plan for Elisa Marie's character, noting it would not unfold in Power Book II: Ghost, but leaving open the possibility of her story being explored in future projects within the broader Power Universe.

Power Legacy Could Be the Perfect Stage

The announcement of Power Legacy has sent the fanbase into overdrive, and rightfully so. The spinoff represents a new chapter for the franchise, and potentially the perfect platform for Elisa Marie Proctor to finally step into a larger role. Given that she grew up surrounded by some of the most powerful and dangerous figures in the Power world, an older Elisa Marie navigating that legacy on her own terms could make for a truly compelling storyline.

Conforti herself seems to understand this. Her comment that she would "really get into it more" with the perspective and maturity she now has as an actress signals that she is not just nostalgic; she is ready. She is hungry. And the Power Universe would be wise to answer that call.

A Fan Favorite Waiting for Her Moment

What makes Elisa Marie such a fan favorite is precisely what Conforti captured so naturally on screen: a child forced to witness adult horrors, processing the world around her with a quiet intelligence that felt unsettling and heartbreaking in equal measure. Audiences never forgot her, and neither, it seems, did the creators.

With Gianni Paolo and Michael Rainey Jr. giving her a platform on The Crew Has It to voice her eagerness, and with Power Legacy now officially in motion, the stars may finally be aligning for Mattea Conforti to reclaim her place in one of television's most celebrated universes. One thing is certain: if the call comes, she will be ready.
excerpt: Actress Mattea Conforti, who played Elisa Marie Proctor in the original Power series, has expressed enthusiastic interest in reprising her role, citing the newly announced Power Legacy spinoff as a potential opportunity for the beloved character's long-awaited return.
